targets.rawSql: SELECT "time" AS "time", COUNT(count_val), device_name FROM qtest_pgdb_schema.stats_count WHERE (count = 'recv_cb' AND legend = 'create_conn_io') GROUP BY "time", count_val, device_name ORDER BY "time"

SELECT "time" AS "time", COUNT(count_val) AS "error", device_name FROM qtest_pgdb_schema.stats_count WHERE (count = 'recv_cb' AND epic = 'error') GROUP BY "time", count_val, device_name ORDER BY "time"
SELECT "time" AS "time", COUNT(count_val), device_name FROM qtest_pgdb_schema.stats_count WHERE (count = 'parse' AND epic = 'error') GROUP BY "time", count_val, device_name ORDER BY "time"

SELECT "time" AS "time", MAX(total_ram) AS "ram", device_name FROM qtest_pgdb_schema.stats_count WHERE (count = 'recv_cb' AND legend = 'create_conn_io') GROUP BY "time", count_val, device_name ORDER BY "time"

SELECT "time" AS "time", COUNT(count_val), device_name, story as server FROM qtest_pgdb_schema.stats_count WHERE (count = 'parse' AND epic = 'hit' AND legend = '/user_get') GROUP BY "time", count_val, device_name, story ORDER BY "time"

targets.rawSql: SELECT "time" AS "time", COUNT(count_val), device_name, session AS "t_session", legend AS "api", story as server FROM qtest_pgdb_schema.stats_count WHERE (count = 'parse' AND message = 'user.token_check' AND legend = '/user_details' AND epic <> session) GROUP BY "time", count_val, device_name, session, legend, story ORDER BY "time"
